title: The Honest Magic Workshop
metaphor: The front feels magical; the backstage, gates and receipts stay inspectable.
groupbuild_sense: Two separate doors, commons and paid managed services; this fixture demonstrates neither a live organization nor a paid product.

lenses.label: Play
lenses.disclaimer: A story is not a real invitation.

lenses.label: Build
lenses.disclaimer: A candidate is not a deployed service.

lenses.label: Big questions
lenses.disclaimer: A coherent idea is not proof.

lenses.label: Stewardship
lenses.disclaimer: A meaningful metaphor is not religious or empirical authority.

stages.label: Wish
stages.truth: A hope or question is recorded. There is no plan or product yet.
stages.next: Define what would count as a useful result.
stages.proof: A stated purpose and its provenance; not proof that it is feasible.
stages.theologian: Express a hope without claiming divine authority.

stages.label: Map
stages.truth: A source-bound plan and alternatives exist. No build is implied.
stages.proof: Versioned plan, participants, uncertainties and alternatives.
stages.builder: Map scope, roles, budget and dependencies.

stages.label: Make
stages.truth: An inspectable prototype can exist in a private workspace. It is not yet a public service.
stages.next: Challenge it with a fair test.
stages.proof: Exact build bytes, source, testable preview and recovery path.
stages.theologian: Draft a community exercise or institution model.

stages.label: Try
stages.truth: Bounded checks are available; they cannot substitute for independent first-use.
stages.next: Record failures and prepare scoped effect review.
stages.proof: Repeatable tests, negative cases, known limitations and test receipt.
stages.kid: Try it, break it, fix it.
stages.theologian: Invite critique without mistaking agreement for truth.

stages.label: Gate
stages.truth: The next external effect is held. A reversible preview is not permission to publish or invite.
stages.next: Identify actual approver, exact target, consent, expiry and rollback limits.
stages.proof: Verified permissions, approved target and current source digest; otherwise HOLD.
stages.kid: Ask before sharing outside your toybox.
stages.builder: Review rights, privacy, budgets and changes.
stages.theologian: Obtain consent and protect freedom to dissent or leave.

stages.label: Go
stages.truth: A real launch would require evidence of an authorized effect. No effect occurred in this demo.
stages.next: Have the receiving system independently verify exact identity and bytes.
stages.proof: Authenticated actor, authorized effect, target, timestamp and exact effect receipt.
stages.kid: Only after permission, open a real door.
stages.builder: Publish or deploy within an approved scope.
stages.philosopher: Put a justified proposal into practice.
stages.theologian: Begin a consented, accountable public activity.

stages.label: Seen
stages.truth: Independent receiver readback must prove receipt. A web page loading is not proof of useful adoption.
stages.next: Invite a voluntary, measurable first-use test.
stages.proof: Receiver-origin identity, exact readproof, scope and any failure states.
stages.kid: Check if the right friend received it.
stages.theologian: Seek accountable witnesses, not authority by proclamation.

stages.label: Grow
stages.truth: Evidence from real people can support usefulness and correction. No success claim is made for this example.
stages.next: Preserve findings, dissent and a reviewable successor.
stages.proof: Consent-based observed outcomes, alternatives, correction/exit and recovery.
stages.kid: Did someone really enjoy it? What should change?
stages.philosopher: Revise the theory with evidence and dissent.
stages.theologian: Assess consequences and stewardship, not theological truth.

exception_terms.label: Hold
exception_terms.meaning: Safely pending until a material gate changes.

exception_terms.label: Fix
exception_terms.meaning: Correct a failed check without hiding the previous result.

exception_terms.label: Fork
exception_terms.meaning: Retain an alternative with lineage and scoped rights.

exception_terms.label: Undo
exception_terms.meaning: Plan reversal where actually possible. Disclosure cannot be undone by label.

exception_terms.label: Exit
exception_terms.meaning: Leave without coercion; preserve needed obligations and rights.

exception_terms.label: Else
exception_terms.meaning: Examine competing choices instead of forcing one future.

term_candidates.name: IA
term_candidates.meaning: Possible 'Imagine & Assemble' mnemonic here; other meanings, especially intelligence amplification, remain distinct.

ideas.name: Moon Garden game
ideas.kid: Make a moon garden where imaginary creatures swap kindness for stars.
ideas.builder: A playful local prototype with no account, chat, or personal data.
ideas.philosopher: Can rules reward collaboration without covertly coercing players?
ideas.theologian: Can wonder and ethical play coexist without religious authority?
ideas.next: Try keyboard-only play and a clear Stop/Undo before any sharing.

ideas.name: Everyone's park
ideas.kid: Imagine a park where every kid can explore.
ideas.builder: A fictional accessibility-first park collaboration plan; external invitations require consent.
ideas.philosopher: Different groups disagree about what fair access means. Preserve their voices.
ideas.theologian: Public stewardship needs meaningful exit, inclusion and rights, not unexamined consensus.
ideas.next: Before any real invitation, confirm actual participants' consent and accessibility requirements.

ideas.name: Big Questions circle
ideas.kid: A pretend clubhouse for asking enormous questions.
ideas.builder: A governance sketch with diverse value interpretations and no real membership.
ideas.philosopher: Explore freedom, existence and institutional legitimacy without silently declaring one answer.
ideas.theologian: Allow plural, voluntary theological reflection without asserting doctrinal or divine authority.
ideas.next: Define how disagreement, appeal and withdrawal work before any real group is formed.
